parameters.help_en: The name of the flow to execute
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the execution. The name must be unique within the same flow. The name must meet the following requirements:

It must start with a letter (a-z or A-Z) or an underscore (_).

It can contain letters (a-z or A-Z), digits (0-9), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

It is case-sensitive.

It must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
执行名称，在同一流程内唯一。取值说明如下：

首字母必须为英文字母（a~z）、（A~Z）或下划线（_）。
支持英文字符（a~z）或（A~Z）、数字（0~9）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
区分大小写。
长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: execution_name

parameters.help_en: The input for the execution. The input must be in the JSON object format
parameters.help_zh: 执行的输入，为JSON对象格式
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The token of a task to be called back after the flow execution is complete
parameters.help_zh: 流程执行结束后回调TaskToken相关任务
parameters.name: callback_fn_f_task_token

parameters.help_en: The version or alias of the flow
parameters.name: qualifier

FlowDefinition.description_en: The definition of the executed flow
FlowDefinition.example:
Legacy version:
"type: flow
version: v1
name: my_flow_name
steps:
 - type: pass
 name: mypass"

New version:
"Type: StateMachine
SpecVersion: v1
Name: my_flow_name
StartAt: my_state
States:
 - Type: Pass
 Name: my_state
 End: true"
